about.photoAlt: Headshot of Behlül Akdağ against a grey background
about.title: About
about.p1: I study computer engineering at Istanbul Aydın University. I started with desktop apps in Java; now I work on Android with Kotlin, backends with Spring Boot, and the web with plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript.
about.p2: In my free time I make games on Roblox with Luau and do powerlifting. LiftLog, the app I wrote to track my training, came out of that.

projects.title: Projects
projects.lead: A selection of software, games and web work. Every one has public code or a live version.
projects.liftlogAlt: LiftLog screens: workout list, progress charts and workout detail
projects.liftlogDesc: A workout tracker: log sets, reps and weights, and follow your personal records and estimated 1RM chart. Android and iPhone (PWA) share the same JWT-secured API.
projects.todoDesc: A pastel-themed task and journal app with dark mode. It has an embedded SQLite database and a planning assistant powered by Google Gemini, packaged as an .exe that runs without installing Java.
projects.garbageAlt: Garbage King: a giant pile of trash bags rising over an amusement park
projects.garbageDesc: A cozy game where you clean a trash-covered amusement park zone by zone. Per-surface dirt, tools that feel physical, and team play. 2,100+ commits in 6 weeks, about 107k lines of Luau.
projects.smashAlt: Smash for Eggs: a character going from a wooden hammer to an electric hammer at level 99
projects.smashDesc: Smash through the floor, steal eggs from sleeping monsters and hatch pets that earn money on your farm. Rewards grow the deeper you dig, with upgrades and rebirths.
projects.chefAlt: Build a Chef: chef characters of different rarities standing in a row
projects.chefDesc: Roll for chef parts, combine five into a chef and run the busiest kitchen on the island. Includes a rarity system, daily deals and trading between friends.
projects.demlikAlt: Home screen of the Demlik café site: the headline 'Slowly brewed, enjoyed' and an illustrated coffee cup
projects.demlikDesc: A one-page site for a fictional Kadıköy coffee shop: tabbed menu, story, opening hours and location. Every illustration is hand-made SVG; it loads fast on phones.
projects.usturaAlt: Home screen of the Ustura barber site: the headline 'Old-school shave, new-school care', a barber pole and a 1987 seal
projects.usturaDesc: A booking-focused site for a classic barber. The form works out free slots from opening hours and service length, hides Mondays and past times, and validates the phone number.
projects.demirAlt: Home screen of the Demir Atölyesi gym site: the headline 'Lift heavy. Lift smart.' and a barbell loaded with colored plates
projects.demirDesc: A strength gym site with a membership calculator: prices update instantly with billing period and student discount. The weekly class schedule filters by day and level.

services.title: Services

services.landingDesc: A fast one-page site: your services, contact details and map in one place.
services.smallBizDesc: A 3–5 page site: menu or service list, gallery, booking or contact form.
services.redesignDesc: I give your old site a modern look and make it mobile-friendly and faster.
services.ctaText: Pricing depends on the project; tell me what you need and I'll reply the same day.
